Question 11(b) [4 marks]: Explain the importance of sequencing and scheduling for this business.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
EVO manufactures batteries and supplies these to electric vehicle producers internationally. Recently EVO has gained a reputation for late deliveries.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Provides detailed cause and effect of the importance of sequencing and scheduling relevant to this business
3 marks: Provides cause and effect of the importance of sequencing and scheduling relevant to this business
2 marks: Provides cause and effect of the importance of sequencing OR scheduling, may or may not link to this business, OR sketches in general terms sequencing and scheduling for this business
1 marks: Makes a general statement about sequencing and scheduling

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
Sequencing (order of tasks) and scheduling (time taken to complete tasks) are important in the transformation process. Tools such as Gantt charts and critical path analysis are used to ensure project completion in the most efficient order and to show which activities cannot be delayed. EVO has earned a reputation for late deliveries. Completing a critical path analysis will enable operations management to identify which activities are on the critical path during battery production so that they are not delayed. Sequencing and scheduling also ensure that tasks are completed in order so no time is wasted double handling goods in production. This is important to maintain their reputation for speed and dependability with their customers.


TEACHER MARKER COMMENTS:
Generally well answered, many linking to the stimulus (reputation for late deliveries). Those who did not score 4/4 lacked: clear definitions (sequencing = order of tasks, scheduling = time taken); syllabus links to CPA or Gantt charts; a clear explanation of how sequencing and scheduling would help (identify slow steps or a more efficient process); business knowledge about likely reasons for late deliveries; a clear link to the performance objectives of speed or dependability.
